notes_for_editor: The tnlandforms entry has no date, height, status or agency. Linking this record to the 1927 tower on the Palistine page is an inference from the shared name and county, not a stated match. The two coordinates (35.21, -78.85055 here; 35.2102, -78.8264 on us-nc-palistine) are about 2 km apart. Confirm before merging or cross-referencing. No source describes the site today.
